gaps: totalDebt FY2008-FY2026: Nintendo has no interest-bearing borrowings on its consolidated balance sheet (left null)
dividendPerShare FY2023: 10-for-1 split on 2022-10-01; company printed interim 630 yen (pre-split) and year-end 123 yen (post-split) and no annual total
notes: dilutedEPS: Nintendo prints '-' for diluted EPS every year because it has no dilutive shares; the value stored is basic profit per share, which the company states equals the undiluted figure (annual report: 'not noted because the Company has not issued any dilutive shares').
10-for-1 stock split effective 2022-10-01. EPS, DPS and shares for FY2022 and earlier are pre-split as originally published (divide by 10 for comparison); FY2023 onward post-split.

totalEquity = 'Shareholders' equity' reference figure printed on p.1 of the release for FY2021-FY2026; for FY2008-FY2020 it is Total shareholders' equity + Total accumulated other comprehensive income (valuation and translation adjustments) from the printed balance sheet (sum of two printed subtotals; excludes minority interests).
capex = 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets' (combined line) from FY2013; FY2008-FY2012 the release shows 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment' only.
cashAndEquivalents = cash and cash equivalents at end of period (cash flow statement), much smaller than cash+deposits+securities on the balance sheet.
sharesOutstanding = shares issued including treasury shares, as printed in the release notes.
employees = consolidated number of employees (persons employed) from the securities report / annual report key-indicators table.
